_about: Everything compiled into the .aar's native libraries that VESvault does not write, pinned. etc/aar-sbom.js writes the release SBOM (libVES-jvm-<version>.cdx.json) from this file, after checking it against the .aar and the prebuilts it was linked from, so a change of prebuilts is a change here. The prebuilts are built by vesmail-android's build-aux/android/build-deps.sh, which checks each source archive against the SHA-256 below (and says how each was verified), and are linked by src/main/cpp/Android.mk. The values below were read from the prebuilts' build directories on 2026-11-05; each source tree there matched its archive file for file.

comment: Android (13691557, +pgo, +bolt, +lto, +mlgo, based on r522817d) clang version 18.0.4 (https://android.googlesource.com/toolchain/llvm-project d8003a456d14a3deb8054cdaa529ffbf02d9b262)

components.name: libVES.c
components.build: the lib/ sources listed in src/main/cpp/Android.mk, with -DHAVE_LIBOQS -DOPENSSL_API_COMPAT=0x10100000L

components.name: openssl
components.build: ./Configure android-arm64 -D__ANDROID_API__=21 no-shared no-tests no-dso no-docs (CFLAGS -Wall -O3), with assembly: ARMv8 AES, PMULL GHASH and SHA, chosen at run time; libcrypto and libssl, linked whole

components.name: curl
components.build: ./configure --host=aarch64-linux-android --with-openssl --disable-shared --enable-static --disable-ldap --disable-ldaps --disable-rtsp --disable-dict --disable-telnet --disable-tftp --disable-pop3 --disable-imap --disable-gopher --disable-mqtt --disable-manual --disable-ftp --disable-file --disable-smtp --disable-ipfs --disable-websockets --disable-ntlm --without-ca-bundle --without-ca-path --without-libpsl --without-libidn2 --without-brotli --without-zstd --without-nghttp2 --without-libssh2 --without-zlib (CFLAGS -O2). Protocols: HTTP HTTPS. Features: alt-svc AsynchDNS HSTS HTTPS-proxy IPv6 Largefile SSL threadsafe UnixSockets. No CA bundle or path: the app supplies the roots

components.name: liboqs
components.licenseNote: liboqs is MIT; some modules in its source tree carry their own licenses, in their folders
components.build: cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DOQS_BUILD_ONLY_LIB=ON -DOQS_USE_OPENSSL=OFF -DOQS_DIST_BUILD=ON (NDK toolchain file, android-21). KEM families as libVES.c's Dockerfile: HQC, Kyber, ML-KEM, NTRU and NTRU Prime on; BIKE, Classic McEliece and FrodoKEM off. Every signature family off

components.name: android-ndk
components.build: the runtime the NDK links into each library; libc, libm and libdl are the device's

components.name: compiler-rt
components.licenseNote: LLVM's compiler-rt builtins as built into NDK r27d's clang 18.0.4 (llvm-project d8003a45): outline atomics and CPU feature detection in libVES.so, long double conversions in both

components.name: bionic-crt
components.licenseNote: crtbegin_so.o and crtend_so.o from the NDK's sysroot: the atexit and dlclose glue every Android shared library carries
